column2: quest flows battery: all-bad-timing streak, DETERMINISTIC. Two independent impossible gates make every trial bad regardless of frame timing under load: thresholdAllowedDurationRatio=0.5 (a responded-early rescue can only bypass this gate, not the next) and thresholdAllowedLatenessSec=0.000001 (measured lateness can never be that small). Zero trials given to QUEST, no counting calls, no sequence rollover. The retry queue (4 initial + 2 capped retries = 6 = maxTrials) is the only bound: the condition must terminate gracefully at exactly 6 attempts, 0 good trials.
